preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 2 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ui <= n and 1 <= vi <= n and 1 <= xi <= 10**9 + 6 and ci in {0, 1} for ui, vi, xi, ci in threads)
preconditions.description: Each thread must connect valid nodes, have valid clamminess, and be either red or black.
There must be exactly n - 1 threads connecting the nodes.

postconditions.description: The output must be the jelliness of the cobweb modulo 10^9 + 7.
If there are no valid paths, the output must be 1.
The jelliness of the cobweb is the product of the clamminess values of all valid paths modulo 10^9 + 7.
